steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Boss, you were right. We lost them.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Those rebels... Crafty little sand beasts, the lot of them. Just five seconds, and it's like they all burrowed into the sand without a trace.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sure enough, and that's why we shouldn't waste our energy on them.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Guard your position well, until they poke their heads out of their holes again.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Sure. You're the boss.
Looks like you found yourself a bunch of loyal subordinates, 'Boss.'

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: They think it'll pay dividends. It's good for morale.
They trust you too. I can tell. It's far more than what a mercenary should afford another mercenary.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Just goes to show how effective Manfred's plan is.

You think real highly of him. I almost forgot. You two are practically brothers from another mother these days, right? Just look at the mansion he gave you. The den alone is larger than your old backyard.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It was a count's estate. I killed its previous owner.
Don't tell me that's weighing on your conscience.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: He was having afternoon tea at the time... His wife and their three children were sitting right in front of him.
Sure, this is nothing like the kind of work we used to take, but you're the one who agreed to the job. Nothing to mourn when our consciences died so long ago.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Then let's not ask these questions. Whatever it is you want to know, just take a look for yourself. Not like you don't know already.
Is you being under a lot of stress supposed to somehow make me feel better?
Whatever. Let's talk about something else. It's not the time for us to find comfort in each other. I'm here because I have some advice for you—Pay attention to what's under your feet.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You mean...
Mercenaries aren't all that trustworthy.
If you don't pay attention to the shadows when you walk, your efforts might just be all for naught.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Is that all you came here for?
No, that's not all.
What I really wanted to say is—After drifting around for so long, she's on the road.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Are our men in position?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Yes, all at that place per the Sarkaz's orders.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Don't be daft. I'm not talking about what the Sarkaz want us to do.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain, are we really going to start this operation tonight? Are you sure we won't...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You trying to ask if we'll fall into Manfred's trap?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Do you think I'm so stupid that I can't tell what he's trying to do?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: No, of course not... I wouldn't dare to...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: He's trying to test me, and I'll let him test me.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Our men are his to order around... but he doesn't know how many of us there are.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: So, we still have to be the Sarkaz's gatekeepers, then?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I hate putting it that way. It makes it sound as though we're the Sarkaz's... the Sarkaz's...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Gah, whatever. We just have to bear with it today. Once we're done with this last thing, we'll leave Londinium straight away.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: W-Will we really? That's wonderful news!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Ever since I was a kid... I... I've always hated Londinium. My parents both came to this place and never went back...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: This city eats people!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Right, I don't like it either. Have you ever seen another city like this? So many plates, so many tall towers, and so many sewers?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Every time I smell that stench... The smell of grease on the nobles' dining tables, it makes me want to puke.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: And now we can finally leave.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Get the word out, and put on your best performance tonight. Do not give Manfred anything he can use against us.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: And I want the ten best fighters to come with me.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: As for you, I want you to tail Manfred... You saw where he was heading, right?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Yes, Captain.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Tonight, I'll rescue our 'spy.'

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I've stayed here in Londinium for so long, I have to at least get one thing done before I can go home with my mind at ease, right?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I... I won't let our leader down again.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Horn, you're back!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I am. Where's Robben?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: The team got back a while ago.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good. Did they find any medicine? Let me check on Salley.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: There's... There's no need.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What are you talking about?! Do you mean Salley...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I still have to see him.
Victoria has lost another fine soldier.
A little girl has lost her father.
How many more must we lose before we finally see the end of this tragedy?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What was Salley's girl's name again? Was it Erin? Elisa? If memory serves, his family lived in County Ascarat.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Blake, pack up his belongings, please. Once the war is over, we'll pay his family a visit.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: But... he didn't leave anything behind.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Nothing at all?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: No, Blake... At the very least, he left a story. We have to go on this journey still. His daughter will want to hear his story.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I will tell her that, even in our darkest hour, her father never gave in to suffering.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Right. I'll come with you, Horn. Once the war is over.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Also, I have a message for you. From Salley.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What... did he say?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: He said—'Sorry, Lieutenant, but you must live on.'

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: He apologized to me.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: He did. And, I understood him. We all did.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: As soldiers, we all considered that we could die out there somewhere, one day.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: But after we saw all that, Salley... No, all of us understood what's far scarier.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Take a look at the state of Londinium. It's our home, but it's become a prison.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Is dying an honorable death too much to ask for?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It shouldn't be.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Indeed, but that's the truth now.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: We all know that well, but... we... we want you to keep marching down this road, because you gave us hope.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Horn... You didn't have to carry all our hopes on your back. It's too much for one person.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's harder... to live, huh?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Ha... Looks like I owe her an apology.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Who's 'her?'

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: A fine Victorian soldier, just like the rest of you.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: She... Let's not talk about this now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Tell everyone we don't have time to mourn.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Did you find out where they're keeping our people?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: There's a high chance.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If the information I got turns out to be correct, the Sarkaz will move them tomorrow morning.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I... I was going to ask what you think.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: You don't have to ask. Just give us the order!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Very well, then. We will begin as soon as the sun sets.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I've marked the most probable locations on the map. Any thoughts?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are... eight spots?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even with our operators, it'll be hard to check all these places in two days.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Unfortunately, all eight fulfill the requirements of a temporary prison.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: There are no settlements near any of them, which means that it's difficult for news to get in and out.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: They're all located near the highway that leads to Central Londinium, which facilitates the Sarkaz fighters' movement around the city.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: And... none of them are connected to the plate we are in.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did the Sarkaz commander figure out you're operating underground?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: He's a smart man. We mustn't underestimate him.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then... If this is where they're keeping prisoners, shouldn't there be a massive security detail guarding the place?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: We thought about that too.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Unfortunately, even though our recon team managed to track the Sarkaz's movement in each plate, they haven't found any openings.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: An abandoned factory. They say it used to make candy... And don't get the wrong idea. That is just what the civilians in the industrial districts usually call it.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: What they actually refined is an organic compound called Loxic Kohl. It's packaged like sweets for children, so everyone's come to call it 'candy'.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A candy factory? Sounds familiar...

options: Make this our top priority in the search.
I think we're pretty close to the answer.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, may I know why?

options: We may know who owns it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, of course. You mean Mr. Thomas?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Thomas has been working with the Sarkaz, right? He said he saw the Sarkaz using his factory for some shady business, and he was almost silenced because of it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not to mention... he has some information that Dublinn wanted too.

options: All the factions opposing the Sarkaz want it...
It's something the Sarkaz don't want anyone to know.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Alright then.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Tell Feist that this factory is our prime objective.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Harmo, keep working on the move. We will keep that option open to us too.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Commander!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: What is it, Lawrence?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: The recon team is back. They ran into some Sarkaz mercenaries aboveground.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Casualties...?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Four injured, and one... captured.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Sorry everyone, the meeting ends here. I need to take a look.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Commander...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Rockrock, what are you doing? We just got your wounds bandaged!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: No... I have something I must tell the commander.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Did you find her...?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Yes, we got news from Lady Golding. She's still at the school in the northern residential district, and she's safe...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: But they were ambushed by the Sarkaz during a social gathering two days ago.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: And the Messenger lady... was taken prisoner.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait a moment, please—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is the Messenger you are referring to the one who requested you to rendezvous with Rhodes Island?

options: The lady who helped us get into Victoria.
She gathered lots of information on Victoria.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Right... That's her.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Amiya, Dr.{@nickname}, our rescue operation has been moved up.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: She's very important to the Self-Salvation Corps. She holds a lot of information, and this might even affect our evacuation operation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, I understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's irreplaceable to Rhodes Island too.

options: This will be our first joint operation.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Good. I have faith that Rhodes Island will help us rescue our imprisoned Messenger from the Sarkaz—

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Our strongest warrior, our most important ally, and our most trusted friend, Lady Heidi Thomson.
